scripts.check:safe: vp run typegen:router && vp run build:eslint-rules && vp check && cd apps/react-router && REACT_ROUTER_TEST_TASK=true vp run test
scripts.ready: vp run check:safe && vp run build:all
scripts.db:up: docker compose -f docker/local/docker-compose.yml --env-file docker/local/.env up -d postgres pgadmin
scripts.db:seed: vp run db:up && vp run seed
scripts.test: cd apps/react-router && REACT_ROUTER_TEST_TASK=true vp run test
